content: iOS Safari file input/camera capture quirks: file picker must be triggered by a direct user gesture in the same event-handler stack calling input.click(), cannot be deferred, or Safari silently ignores it. Hidden inputs must not use display:none; use visually-hidden techniques (position:absolute; left:-9999px) with a label as visible trigger. accept=image/* with capture attribute needed for direct camera capture. When OS camera app is invoked, Safari backgrounds/suspends the tab; on return the page can lose in-memory JS state (form data) if iOS reclaims the tab under memory pressure - captured file survives via input change event, but anything not yet persisted (multi-step form) can be lost.
